tagline: 理光胶片单反相机，1995 年发布
description: 理光于1995年推出的胶片单反相机。配备35-70 mm / f5.0-f9.5 (6 elements 5 groups). 1.2 m (4 fl.)-inf.。快门速度Programmed Electronic shutter, 1/5-1/250 sec.。感光度ISO 100, 400. Compatible with DX system.。Active auto focus.。

specs.镜头: 35-70 mm / f5.0-f9.5 (6 elements 5 groups). 1.2 m (4 fl.)-inf.
specs.取景器: Real image zoom viewfinder Mag. x 0.33-0.58, Field of view about 83%
specs.曝光测光: Programmed AE with CdS cell Coupling range EV8.0-15.0 (ISO 100)
specs.闪光灯: Electronic flash automatically activates in dim light, turning off Flash is possible
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh RZ-770 is a 35mm compact point and shoot camera.
